screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.

The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.

By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.

“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.

It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.

The plan failed.
The date didn’t.

He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.
